stem.text: A $3.0\text{ g}$ sample of $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$ powder is stirred into $50\text{ cm}^3$ of $1.0\text{ mol dm}^{-3}\text{ HCl}$. The volume of $\text{CO}_2$ produced is $600\text{ cm}^3$.
Which volume of $\text{CO}_2$ is produced if $1.0\text{ g}$ of $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$ powder is stirred into $50\text{ cm}^3$ of $1.0\text{ mol dm}^{-3}\text{ HCl}$ under the same conditions?
